t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Always keep fingers over the s and k keys, stay focussed on the screen at all times. The breaks are at good times. Best to work with no distractions

vb_textbox.text: Make sure you have no distractions and concentrate fully. You have to be very quick on the keys so have your fingers ready on the s and k key. I found that the gnomes with a larger hat tended to give more mushrooms but also the 5x i pressed k and the 1x I pressed s which seemed to work well
